blocks.html: ROBINSONS COMMUNITIES SPEND QUALITY TIME WITH EMOTIONALLY DISABLED PATIENTS

The management team of Robinsons Communities recently spent quality time with emotionally disabled patients currently located in a public medical facility in Metro Manila. The Team, led by is Business Development Director Ted Bernas and Marketing Manager Kristynne Tan, spent a day with recovering patients who have undergone deep emotional trauma. As part of their recovery program, the patients were provided by Robinsons Communities with fun and stimulating activities which include games, mascot appearances, and gift-giving.

Photo shows emotional disabled patients pose happily with Jollibee and employees from Robinsons Communities (2nd row seated from L-R) Ma. Kathlyn Ravanilla, Katrina Tordilla, Kristynne Tan, Ted Bernas, Edes Cootauco and Rachelle Go.
